description: Any cross-section or history (one ticker's full snapshot: get_summary). Give fields and filters (names from get_schema), then EITHER date (default latest) OR start+end. One date with filters, tickers, sort_by or limit: a ranked screen. One date with only fields: every asset. A range: every row in it, weekly by default past ~6 months; market_/macro_ filters keep only dates in that regime, other filters apply after the rows are fetched, so narrow with tickers, member_of or asset_class. Big pulls: store_as + fetch_all, then query_data.

adjustment.description: With ohlcv: split (default), split_dividend (total return) or raw (as traded).

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

dry_run.description: Range: returns what it would cost in credits. No data, no charge.

fetch_all.description: Follow every page into store_as in this one call.

filters.description: Up to 10; a row must match all of them, and null matches none. E.g. [{"field":"momentum_rsi_zone","op":"in","value":["oversold"]}].

held_by.description: Only assets this fund held on the row's date: fund ticker (IVV) or SEC series id.

limit.description: Rows on one date (default 20, max 250); rows per page on a range.

member_of.description: Only members of this index on the row's date, e.g. sp500. Ids: get_indexes.

offset.description: One date: skip this many ranked rows.

page_token.description: Range: a token from page_tokens or next_page_token (same params).

sort_by.description: Ticker field to rank by (one date).

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

timeframe.description: Default: weekly for ranges over ~6 months, else daily.

name: query
